newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 6.94 million barrels in the week ended May 9 to 322.63 million barrels from 315.69 million the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 5.79 million barrels in the week to 256.17 million barrels.
Distillate stocks fell 1.10 million barrels to 96.46 million barrels from 97.56 million the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 839,000 barrels to 31.33 million barrels.
It said gasoline production rose 341,000 barrels in the week to 8.11 million bpd from 7.77 million in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks rose 6.51 million barrels in the week to 197.06 million barrels from 190.55 million barrels the previous week.
Percent of stocks capacity rose to 96.9 percent from 94.5 percent the previous week.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 2.35 million barrels to 37.81 million barrels from 35.47 million barrels the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.74 million barrels from 14.41 million the previous week.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 39.67 million barrels from 41.81 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports fell to 7.57 million barrels per day from 8.11 million, API said.
